pages.x: Premium Drones Georgia is the official and exclusive XAG dealer in the Caucasus region. Our story Experience earned in the field. PDG was founded in 2022 and has worked in the field with agricultural drones since 2023. The team trained at XAG Academy in China, and with the XAG V40, P100 and P100 Pro we have handled batteries, charging, parts, service and operator preparation in practice. Our current focus is the XAG P150 MAX. We provide the full XAG ecosystem: drones, batteries, chargers, generators, parts, service and training — for farmers, service companies and government and municipal buyers. Our mission is to bring top-class, state-of-the-art technology to Georgian agriculture on a mass scale. Thousands of hectares in real field conditions Tbilisi Lagodekhi About XAG XAG is a world leader in agricultural drones and robots. Its team was formed in 2007–2008, and today it makes agricultural drones, rovers, a tractor autopilot and smart-farm devices. According to XAG, it holds the most patents in this field. XAG aims to build the infrastructure of agriculture for the next 100 years, that will provide the world with sufficient, diversified, and safe food. In Georgia, PDG offers XAG equipment, parts, service and training. pages.d: XAG drone batteries: how many you need, how to charge them in the field and how to look after them — how much the drone can work per day.
pages.x: Guide The number of batteries, the charging setup and their care decide how much the drone can work in a day. How many batteries you need The drone flies while the next battery charges. Flight time and charging time have to match, so larger areas need more batteries and chargers. We will choose the right number for your area and working day together. Power in the field There is not always mains power in the field. A generator and a parallel charging kit let you charge where you work. Use the equipment the manufacturer recommends. Cooling and temperature On a hot day a battery warms up in flight. Cool it before charging, for example with a cooling tank. Charging a hot battery shortens its life. Storage between seasons After the season, store batteries in a dry, cool place at the charge level the manufacturer specifies. Do not use a damaged or swollen battery.

pages.d: How to choose an agricultural drone: start with the work - field mapping, spraying, granule spreading, cargo transport - then choose the aircraft and equipment.
pages.x: Guide Start with the work you need to do. Then choose the equipment. Your fields and crops Assess the area, field shape, terrain and access roads. Open fields, vineyards and orchards need different planning. Workload is about more than hectares alone. The complete workflow Plan charging, water supply, transport and staffing alongside the drone. The number of batteries and chargers should match your actual working schedule. Service and parts Before buying, establish how you will receive technical support, which parts are available and what the training covers. Compare the cost of the complete package and its operation. A practical demonstration Describe your crops, acreage and tasks during the consultation. Request an offer suited to your conditions and verify the drone's capabilities in the manufacturer's documentation.

pages.d: Frequent questions: where to buy an agricultural drone in Georgia, XAG P150 MAX packages and prices, spraying service, repair, parts and training.
pages.x: Answers to the most common questions about XAG drones and our service. What is a spraying drone? A spraying drone is an agricultural drone that applies crop protection products over a field automatically, following a GPS/RTK route. With optional modules (RevoCast 5, RevoSling) the XAG P150 MAX also spreads granules and carries cargo. XAG P150 MAX How does drone spraying differ from conventional spraying? The drone never drives into the field: no soil compaction or crop damage, it works on wet ground and slopes, applies a precise rate, and the operator works away from the treated area, which reduces exposure to the chemical. Protective equipment is still needed when mixing the solution and filling the tank. Choose the product and rate with your agronomist. How much does the XAG P150 MAX cost in Georgia? Packages: Starter ₾75,999, Plus ₾83,999, Pro ₾87,999, Business ₾104,999. You can build your own combination in the configurator. See what each includes and every price in the shop. Configurator · Ready packages Where can I buy XAG drone parts? From Premium Drones Georgia, the official XAG dealer. pages.d: How to prepare for an agricultural drone’s first flight: operator training, technical checks, field mapping and work planning.
pages.x: In practice Training, technical checks and planning your work. Know your equipment Complete practical training for your model and read the manufacturer's manual. Learn the operating modes, warnings and procedures for stopping a flight before you begin. Check the drone Follow the manufacturer's checklist to inspect the frame, propellers, batteries and spraying system. Do not start a flight with faulty equipment or unresolved warnings. Inspect the work site Identify obstacles, power lines and areas where people may be present. Assess the weather and whether the work fits the manufacturer's limits and applicable requirements. Plan the treatment Choose the product and application rate with an agronomist and according to the product label. During training, check operating parameters against the manufacturer's instructions. This guide does not replace practical training.

pages.d: XAG agricultural drone service and original parts in Georgia: pre-season checks, repair and parts from local stock.
pages.x: In practice In season, even one day of downtime is expensive. Service and parts close by keep that time short. Pre-season check Before the season, check the motors, propellers, pumps, nozzles and cables. A small fault found early saves a long stop in the field. Original parts A non-original part can change how the drone works and how safe it is. Original XAG parts for the P150 MAX are in stock in our warehouse in Georgia. Regular care After every working day, rinse the spraying system and inspect the drone. Follow the manufacturer’s manual or ask our team about care routines. When something is not right If the drone shows a warning or behaves strangely, stop flying and contact us. We do the diagnostics and repairs ourselves.
